title: A.K. Roy v. Union of India (NSA Case)

content.caseIdentity: A.K. Roy v. Union of India (NSA Case), (1982) 1 SCC 271
content.holding: Upheld National Security Act 1980; held that if the State is assisted by a prosecutor before the Advisory Board, the detenu must be permitted legal counsel; established right to a next friend.
content.relevance: Benchmark ruling on preventive detention procedure and Advisory Boards.
